div.head: IV As 6.2b
div.ab: ⁊ gif hine hwa lecge binnan ðæm fyrste, þonne gebete he ðæs mundbyrde ðe he ær sohte, oþþe he hine twelfa sum ladige, þæt he þa socne nyste.
⁊ gif hine hwa licge binnan ðæm fyrste, þonne gebete ge ðæs mundbyrde ðe he ær sohte, oþþe he hine twelfa sum ladige, þæt he þa socne nyste.

If anyone slays him within that period of respite, he shall pay as compensation the mundbyrd of him to whom the thief has fled to clear himself [by asseverating] with the support of eleven others that he was not aware that the privilege of sanctuary had been obtained.
Und wenn ihn einer binnen dieser Frist erschlägt, dann büsse er dessen Schutzgewalt, welchen jener zuvor aufgesucht hatte, oder reinige sich selbzwölft, dass er dies Asyl nicht gekannt habe.

And if anyone kills him within this period of respite, then let him pay compensation for the protection of the one whom he had sought out, or clear himself as one of twelve that he did not know of this sanctuary.
div.note: 6.2b is missing from the Latin on p. 172 — perhaps rightly (Liebermann).
